name: Throughput & Live Traffic
description: On-demand native iperf3 3.11 client tests and temporary bounded servers with structured endpoint, protocol, stream, bitrate, direction, bind, and output controls.
help_text: The exact installed binary has silent -h/--help output; its embedded 3.11 option table was inspected. Server mode requires an exact current local bind address, is never daemonized, and ends after one client or the validated window.
